title: Paychex Flex - Tax filing errors and hidden fees drive a 1.1/5 Trustpilot rating
clean_text: While Paychex scores a respectable 4.2/5 on G2 from business decision-makers, end-user reviews on Trustpilot give it just 1.1/5. Customers report service errors including mistakes on federal tax filings, miscalculations of final pay for departing employees, and failure to deposit taxes on time. Customer support failures appear in 60-75% of negative reviews, with complaints describing responses that take a long time and frequent turnover of assigned payroll representatives, sometimes changing every other month. Hidden fees are reported to routinely exceed initial quotes by 100% or more, and the benefits module (Flock) reportedly does not communicate properly with the FSA/HSA module when employees transition between health plans.
